name: Relocatable mapping hinted inside the measured Apple carveout
required_postconditions: a writable anonymous mapping succeeds; relocation is acceptable

failure_sink.description: the mapping remains valid when the host ignores the unavailable hint and chooses another address

extraction_limitations: The address is aligned and comes from the measured Apple Silicon/Rosetta no-access carveout; Linux may honour it and then contributes no RS-VM-0020 witness.
x_groundtruth: On measured macOS profiles the hint lies inside an unavailable range, yet mmap without MAP_FIXED must succeed elsewhere. satisfied-relocated simultaneously proves contract success and the ignored hint.
